update_message:
What's New in 2.2.0:

⚙️ Advanced Settings Screen
• New Poweramp-style hierarchical settings with 6 categories
• Audio Engine, Mix & Fade, DSP & Hardware, Theme & UI
• Player & Artwork customization with FAB icon/size controls
• Fonts & Lists density settings
• Glassmorphism cards with gradient icons and glow effects
• Spring physics animated switches and sliders

🔄 Beautiful Update UI
• Redesigned update section in Settings with gradient card
• Shows current version and available update version
• "What's New" changelog preview with expand option
• Download progress bar with percentage indicator
• Different visual states for mandatory vs optional updates
• One-tap Check for Updates / Download & Install button

🎯 FAB Customization
• Choose from 5 icon styles (Music Note+, Plus, Folder+, Library, Queue)
• 4 size options (Small 48dp, Medium 56dp, Large 64dp, XL 72dp)
• Settings persist and apply instantly
• Animated glow effect with accent colors

💾 Queue Persistence
• Full queue saved on app exit/background
• Restores queue, position, shuffle, and repeat modes
• Resumes playback state on app restart

🐛 Bug Fixes
• Fixed missing imports causing FAB settings to not work
• Fixed ExtendedAudioSettingsService not connected to UI
• Added proper navigation to Advanced Settings screen
• Fixed reactive streams to emit initial values correctly

🎨 UI/UX Improvements
• Smoother animations throughout the app
• Better visual feedback on settings changes
• Consistent gradient styling across all cards
